notablePrerequisites:
Curiosity attached to Walking Ballista.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters.
Wizard Class is level three.
description:
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Repeat.
